quests.title: House of the Soulless

dialogue.t: Uh, who are you...? But whoever you are, this place is off-limits to ordinary visitors. Please do not linger here either.
(Looking more closely, there are signs of scraping on the floor around the vase...)
(You also spot what looks like cat scratches on the bottom of the vase. Could this be...)
Hey, look! The door's open! Now we can go farther in!
Uh, who are you...? But whoever you are, this place is off-limits to ordinary visitors. Please do not linger here either.
